player_prompt.intro:
Uyasolisa idludo le Sokoban. Uwena umdlali kantsi uyahamba kuphakamisa bobhokisi kuze kwenye indawo zazo.
        Lapho ukhona ngalinye nobhokisi, ungakuphakamisa ngokuhamba ngendlela imbe.
        Awukwati kuphakamisa ibhokisi ngaphandle kwemadwaleni, futsi awukwati kuyikhipha ibhokisi.
        Kuze kwelududo, tinhlanganiso tibonakala njengesi: 
        - Umdlali (wena) ubonakala njenga 'P' 
        - Madwaleni abonakala nge '#' 
        - Bobhokisi babonakala nge 'X' 
        - Indawo zaphakanyo ezingenaso bobhokisi zibonakala nge 'O'
        - Bobhokisi abo kwenye indawo zaphakanyo bonakala nge '√'
        Ungangisebenta [w] ukwele phezulu, [a] ukwele ekunene, [s] ukwele phansi, kanye ne [d] ukwele ekunyene.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uhamba olungezwe awulandeli ifomati leyo yinhle. Sebenzisa [up], [down], [left], [right] noma [w], [a], [s], [d].
